subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: Should durable memory v1 make provenance a schema-level invariant before promotion, retrieval, merge/edit, and review flows proceed?
rationale: This chooses storage shape, plugin boundary ownership, lineage semantics, and security posture, so automation cannot safely pick the permanent contract.

options.title: Schema-level provenance first
options.body: Define source refs, multi-source lineage, and merge/edit preservation as part of the v1 active-memory schema before broader write/review surfaces land.

options.title: Keep lightweight citations
options.body: Treat current path#line citations and wiki evidence as enough for now, leaving durable provenance as a later redesign.

options.title: Move provenance to wiki layer
options.body: Keep active memory lean and make Memory Wiki the provenance-rich belief layer, accepting lighter active-memory entries.

recommendation.title: Schema-level provenance first
recommendation.body: Define source refs, multi-source lineage, and merge/edit preservation as part of the v1 active-memory schema before broader write/review surfaces land.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and schema history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the product contract decision.
